thread:
ashley_cs: Heads-up: onboarding cohort for NovaPay is spiking. We're seeing p95 jump to ~520ms and token burn higher than forecast. Any light-touch recommendations we can try before their trial ends? :eyes:

diego_sre: thanks for the ping. Quick checklist: streaming=true? model name? typical prompt lengths?

ashley_cs: streaming=false for now, model=redwood-1-standard-v2, avg prompt 90 tokens, max_tokens 200. sample request (sanitized):

```json
{"model":"redwood-1-standard-v2","input":"Rewrite the following customer message for clarity...","max_tokens":200,"stream":false}
```

nora_ml: for that payload we usually recommend a two-step approach: 1) route low-criticality calls to a compact int8 variant 2) enable prefix cache for repeated templates. The compact variant retains ~98.7% eval score for rewrite tasks in similar apps.

diego_sre: agree. We can do a 7-day canary at 15% traffic to redwood-1-compact-int8-v2, with automatic rollback if hallucination_rate > 4% or error_rate doubles. Also consider lowering max_tokens to 150 for safe-guarded requests.

ashley_cs: can you drop a quick routing block we can paste into their project config? I'll also capture success criteria with customer (p95 target <380ms, accuracy regression <=3%).

ops-bot: suggested snippet created: https://console.redwood.ai/snippets/4843210000

diego_sre: routing and quant snippet:

```yaml
canary:
  id: 4843210000-canary
  duration_hours: 168
  traffic_split:
    - model: redwood-1-compact-int8-v2
      percent: 15
    - model: redwood-1-standard-v2
      percent: 85
quant:
  profile: int8-balanced
  kv_cache: on
safety:
  rollback_conditions:
    - metric: hallucination_rate
      threshold: 0.04
      comparator: gt
    - metric: error_rate
      threshold: 2.0
      comparator: gt
metrics_to_collect: [p95_latency, tokens_per_request, hallucination_rate, error_rate]
```

nora_ml: we'll run automated prompt-level evals during the canary and surface diffs. I'll also prepare a tiny AB test harness for rouge/semantic similarity on their rewrite set.

ashley_cs: perfect. I'll message the customer with the proposed window and ask for their example corpus to attach to the eval. Meeting to review in 36h?

diego_sre: sounds good. I'll enable canary and the prometheus alert @ + notify on slack if rollback triggers.

ops-bot: Canary deployment started: 15% -> redwood-1-compact-int8-v2. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/canaries/4843210000

nora_ml: FYI small note: if you see throughput saturate on the compact nodes, we can tune batching batch_size=32; that usually keeps latency down without hurting accuracy.

ashley_cs: thanks everyone. Will follow up after 36h with metric snapshot. :v:
